description: This file defines the ConnectCasesClient class for the AWS SDK PHP library, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Connect Cases service. It provides method annotations mapping to various API operations for managing cases, domains, fields, layouts, templates, and related resources.

classes.name: ConnectCasesClient
classes.description: This class extends AwsClient and provides methods for interacting with the Amazon Connect Cases service, including operations like createCase, getCase, deleteDomain, listTemplates, etc.

methods.name: batchGetField
methods.description: Method to retrieve multiple fields by batch.

methods.name: createCase
methods.description: Creates a new case in Amazon Connect Cases.

methods.name: createDomain
methods.description: Creates a new domain for cases.

methods.name: getCase
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific case.
